questions.question: X is the greatest number by which, when 2460, 2633 and 2806 are divided, the remainder in each case is the same. What is the sum of digits of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eb83bfc4977a2929c94502d2fedf9a8c73dab6dd1130fc7a3fd12815b9eaed9.png] 

If x is the greatest number by which, when 2460, 2633 and 2806 are divided, the remainder in each case same, then

2633 – 2460 = 173

2806 – 2633 = 173

2806 – 2460 = 346

So, x = 173

Sum of the digit of 173 = 1 + 7 + 3 = 11

questions.question: If the simple interest on a sum of Rs x at 6% p.a. for two years is double the simple interest on another sum of Rs y at 9% per annum for three years, then which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SI on Rs x at 6% p.a. for 2 yr = 2 × SI on Rs y at 9% p.a for 3 yr

**Concpt used:**

SI = prt/100

P → principal r → rate of interest

 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

(x × 6 × 2)/100 = 2 × (y × 9 × 3)/100

⇒ x = 4.5y

questions.question: A wire encloses an area of 616 cm² when it is bent in the form of a circle. If the wire is bent in the form of a square, then its area (in cm²) is very nearly equal to: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of circle formed after bending a wire = 616 cm2

**Formula used:**

Circumference of the circle = 2πr

Area of circle = πr²

where r → radius of the circle

Perimeter of the square = 4a

where a → side of the square

**Calculations:**

Area of the circle = 616 cm²

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 616

⇒ r² = 616 × (7/22) = 28 × 7

⇒ r = √2 × 2 × 7 × 7

⇒ r = 2 × 7

⇒ r = 14 cm

Circumference of the circle 

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 88cm

As Perimeter of the square = Circumference of the circle

⇒ 4a = 88

⇒ a = 22

**Area of the square = a² = 22 × 22 = 484cm²**

questions.question: To do a certain work, the ratio of efficiencies of A and B is 3 : 7, working together, they can complete a work in 14 days. B started the work and after working for 8 days. He left and A complete the remaining work. For how many days did A work?
questions.solution:
Efficiency of A to B = 3 : 7

Total work = (3 + 7) × 14 = 140

Work done by B in 8 days = 7 × 8 = 56

Remaining work = 140 – 56 = 84

Remaining work A will complete in = 84/3 = 28 days

questions.question: A car travels for 6 hours at different speeds. For the first two hours at 60 m/s, for the next 2 hours at 50 m/s and for the remaining time at x m/s. If the average speed for the entire journey is 52 m/s, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal time intervals (2 hours each), the average speed over the entire journey is simply the arithmetic mean of the individual speeds.

⇒ Average Speed = (S₁ + S₂ + S₃) ÷ 3

⇒ 52 = (60 + 50 + x) ÷ 3

⇒ 156 = 110 + x ⇒ x = 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Time = 6 hours

Speed for the first 2 hours = 60 m/s

Speed for the next 2 hours = 50 m/s

Speed for the remaining time = x m/s

Average speed for the entire journey = 52 m/s

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4618f54175c09a333679298b4d16b7d08661976ac6d78bceb71f39415f13cec6.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Remaining time for the last part of the journey = 6 − 2 − 2 = 2 hours

⇒ Since time acts directly as a weight in the average calculation, the unit conversion factor from hours to seconds cancels out in the numerator and denominator.

⇒ Average Speed = [(S₁ × T₁) + (S₂ × T₂) + (S₃ × T₃)] ÷ Total Time

⇒ 52 = [(60 × 2) + (50 × 2) + (x × 2)] ÷ 6

⇒ 52 = (120 + 100 + 2x) ÷ 6

⇒ 52 × 6 = 220 + 2x

⇒ 312 = 220 + 2x

⇒ 2x = 312 − 220

⇒ 2x = 92

⇒ x = 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Time Intervals)

If a journey is covered in equal time intervals at different speeds, the average speed is simply the arithmetic mean of those speeds: Sₐvg = (S₁ + S₂ + ... + Sₙ) ÷ n.

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If equal distances are covered at different speeds, the average speed is the harmonic mean of the speeds. For exactly two equal distances, the formula is: Sₐvg = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

General Average Speed Formula

For any standard journey with varying times and distances, the average speed is universally calculated as the ratio of total distance to total time: Sₐvg = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

questions.question: The average of 12 numbers is 18.5 The average of first six numbers Is 16.8 and that of the last seven numbers is 17.4 If the 6th number is excluded, then what is the average (correct to one decimal place) of remaining 11 numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 12 numbers = 18.5

Sum of 12 numbers = 18.5 × 12 = 222

Average of first 6 numbers = 16.8

Sum of first 6 numbers = 16.8 × 6 = 100.8

Average of last 7 numbers = 17.4

Sum of last 7 numbers = 17.4 × 7 = 121.8

6th number = 100.8 + 121.8 – 222 = 222.6 – 222 = 0.6

Sum of 11 number = 222 – 0.6 = 221.4

Average of 11 number = 221.4/11 = 20.1

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 3200 was to be divided between A, B, C and D in the ratio 4: 6 : 7: 3. But by mistake, it was divided in the ratio 3: 5: 6: 2 As a result, who got 16(2)/(3)\% less than her due?
questions.solution:
Correct ratio of A, B, C and D = 4x : 6x : 7x : 3x

4x + 6x + 7x + 3x = 3200

20x = 3200

x = 3200/20 = 160

Share of A = 4 × 160 = 640

Share of B = 6 × 160 = 960

Share of C = 7 × 160 = 1120

Share of D = 3 × 160 = 480

Wrong ratio of A,B, C and D = 3x : 5x : 6x : 2x

3x + 5x + 6x + 2x = 3200

16x = 3200

x = 3200/16 = 200

Wrong share of A = 3 × 200 = 600

Wrong share of B = 5 × 200 = 1000

Wrong share of C = 6 × 200 = 1200

Wrong share of D = 2 × 200 = 400

A got less than her due = [(640 – 600)/640] × 100 = 6.25%

B got less than her due = [(960 – 1000)/960] × 100 = 4.16%

C got less than her due = [(1120 – 1000)/1120] × 100 = 7.14%

D got less than her due = [(480 – 400)/480] × 100 = 16%

questions.question: The diameter of the base of a right circular cone is 10 cm and its height is 12cm. What is the total surface area (in cm²) of the cone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of the base of a right circular cone = 10 cm

So, Radius of the cone = 10/2 = 5 cm

Height of the cone (h) = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of right circular cone = πr(l + r)

where r → radius of the base of cone

l → slant height of the cone

l² = h² + r²

**Calculation:**

l² = 5² + 12²

⇒ l² = 25 + 144 = 169

⇒ l = √169 = 13 cm

Total surface area of the cone

⇒ π × 5(13 + 5)

⇒ π × 5 × 18 = 90π cm²

**∴ The total surface area of cone = 90π cm2**

questions.question: What is the ratio of the mean proportional between 4.5 and 0.5 and the third proportional to 4.5 and 9.0?
questions.solution:
Let mean proportion between 4.5 and 0.5 be x, then

4.5 : x :: x : 0.5

⇒ 4.5/x = x/0.5

x² = 4.5 × 0.5 = 2.25

x = √2.25

x = 1.5

Let third proportion between 4.5 and 9 be y, then

4.5 : 9 :: 9 : y

4.5/9 = 9/y

y = (9 × 9)/4.5

y = 18

Ratio of x : y = 1.5 : 18 = 1 : 12

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Mean proportional between 4.5 and 0.5 = √(4.5 × 0.5) = 1.5

Third proportional between 4.5 and 9 = (9 × 9)/4.5 = 18

Required ratio = 1.5 : 18 = 1 : 12

questions.question: Amit bought an article for Rs. 310 and sold it at a loss of 25%. With this money, he bought another article and sold it at a gain of 40% What was his overall gain or loss percent?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Required profit = 40 – 25 – [(40 × 25)/100] = 5%

**Detailed method: **

Let CP of the article bought by Amit be Rs 100

SP of the article = 100 × [75/100] = 75

Rs. 75 he bought another article, So

SP of another article = 75 × (140/100) = 105

Profit = 100 - 105 = 5

Profit percentage = [5/100] × 100 = 5%
